title: Hardcoded Range Mappings
pattern: Writing multiple sequential conditional calculations containing hardcoded logical bounds and parallel arithmetic formulas.
why_bad: A change to range boundaries or pricing rates requires tracing and carefully altering several intertwined boundary checks, creating high maintenance overhead.
detection: A series of `if` statements or arithmetic steps executing similar segment boundary extraction on a variable using literal constants.
source: *Refactoring: Improving the Design of Existing Code* (1st Edition), "Extract Method" / "Substitute Algorithm", p. 110.
